title: Inside McDonald’s push to have AI price your Big Mac

reading.body:
This incident cannot be characterised as a failure mode, because the reporting available does not describe one. The only substantive document in the record is a PDF that contains no readable article text, so no event, system, deployment or outcome can be identified from it. The headline attached to the record concerns a declaration by Cynthia S. Arato, but the body gives no account of what was declared or in what proceeding.

What the record does show is a documentation failure rather than a system failure. A file that should carry the substance of a legal declaration was captured or extracted in a form that carries none of it, and a catalogue entry was built around it. Catching this would have required a check at ingestion that the extracted text is readable and non-empty before the item is treated as a source.

It is not established that any AI system behaved incorrectly, that any declaration made a false claim, or that the McDonald's headline and the Arato declaration describe the same matter. The presence of a headline is not evidence of the events it names.
